description: This file defines a PHP class 'ECB' within the Opencart e-commerce platform. The class is a controller that retrieves exchange rates from the European Central Bank's daily XML feed, processes the data, and updates the currency conversion rates in the system database.

classes.name: ECB
classes.description: A controller class responsible for fetching currency exchange rates from the ECB and updating the system's currency data.

methods.name: currency
methods.description: Fetches daily currency rates from ECB, processes XML data, and updates currency exchange rates if enabled.
